name: tracker-release-copy-safety
goal: A leftover rsync receiver from a failed or timed-out release copy can never change the live Tracker release, and every host is re-verified against SHA256SUMS after the soak

evidence: Regression tkx6js: MB2 live release 9b46343338 harness truncated to 36428681 B (mode 0600) 11 min after a good release. Release-time shasum had passed on both Macs. Reproduced on this Mac with real openrsync and a dropped fake-ssh connection: a receiver left by a failed rsync --partial copy keeps a handle on its destination directory, which follows the publishing rename, and renames its partial file over harness when the dead connection ends (live 20000017 B -> about 5.98 MB, mode 0600). Without --partial the live file stayed intact. The recipe resumed into one directory and renamed it live without stopping receivers.

The release copy steps were never in the repo; each release session copied the previous verification-*/stage.sh and checked checksums only at publish time. Missing category: release transport lifecycle (dropped connection, surviving receiver, publish, soak). New coverage: test/tracker-release-copy.test.ts with test/support/release-copy (real rsync, fake ssh hosts, orphan stand-in modelling the observed openrsync behaviour), run by test:unit. The recipe is committed first, unchanged apart from its unit uid.
loop record red at 5f0519928f: 6/6 failed on the unchanged recipe; headline 'expected 50000 to be 200017' (the live harness was replaced by the orphan partial after publish).

Fresh staging dir per attempt without --partial; SIGKILL and confirm release receivers gone before each attempt, after failed or interrupted ones and before publish (fail closed); publish a host-local copy in a directory rsync never wrote to; soak re-verifies SHA256SUMS, signature and no receivers on this computer and every host.
6a61c789e9: scripts/tracker-release-copy.sh and the 'Release copy and soak' section of specification/tracker-native-service.md. The test runs in test:unit.
loop record green passed at 6a61c789e9 with unchanged tests and command.

Detached temporary worktree at the fix commit: original recipe -> 6/6 fail; only --partial restored -> the fresh-directory test fails; receiver sweep disabled -> 'nothing is published while a receiver cannot be stopped' fails; restored -> 6/6 pass. Worktree removed. No test isolates the host-local publish copy on its own.
